english.title: Exceed temporary 40mph speed restriction - roadworks - ACD
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) drove a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), at a speed exceeding 40 miles per hour, in contravention of a temporary maximum speed restriction imposed by a Local traffic Order, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCAL TRAFFIC ORDER..)
english.legislation: Contrary to the above Local Traffic Order and section 16(1) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:

(ii) See also H6517 for the manned equipment version of this offence.
(iii) A notice of intended prosecution IS required for this offence.
